entities.name: Firja
entities.description: Firja, Judge of Valor, an angel cleric from Kaldheim and the first Valkyrie to be both shepherd and reaper.

entities.name: Starnheim
entities.description: Realm where shepherds lead the worthy dead.

entities.name: Istfell
entities.description: Realm to which reapers drag the unworthy.

entities.name: Egon
entities.description: God of death whom Firja keeps from entering Starnheim before his time.

entities.name: Ranar
entities.description: Warrior spirit appointed guardian of the passage between Istfell and Starnheim.

entities.name: Valkyries
entities.description: Shepherds and reapers who judge the fallen.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion in which Firja defended Kaldheim.

events.summary: Firja has a vision that a warrior who fled battle is destined for greatness, disagreeing with her reaper counterpart.
Firja strikes down the reaper and absorbs her essence, growing black wings beside her white ones.
events.quote: Firja, in an unprecedented act, struck the reaper down.

events.summary: Firja appoints Ranar guardian of the passage to halt Egon's invasion.
events.quote: appointed the warrior spirit Ranar as guardian of the passage between Istfell and Starnheim

events.summary: Firja fights in defense of Kaldheim during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Firja fought in defense of Kaldheim during the New Phyrexian Invasion

relations.note: She prevents him from entering Starnheim before his time.
relations.quote: Firja is responsible for preventing the god Egon from entering Starnheim before his time.
appointed the warrior spirit Ranar as guardian
